text:
**Yes.** The evidence identifies a corroborated 0.7-hectare tree-cover loss event in 2023, covering 1.2% of the asset. The entire event area was mapped as forest in the JRC 2020 reference.

The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the event area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was classified as native forest. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish whether the land was permanently converted from forest.

An additional 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, so it was not counted as an event.
